description:
`crates/gf2-algebra/src/parallel.rs` provides a parallel permanent for $\mathbb{F}_3$ only. The $\mathbb{F}_5$ and $\mathbb{F}_7$ bipedal permanents run on one thread.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Parallel permanents for $\mathbb{F}_5$ and $\mathbb{F}_7$ return the single-thread result for every supported $n$, identically across worker counts, covered by the shared permanent suite.
- [aspirational] REQ-02: A committed receipt from an uncontended host reports the scaling under the repository's benchmark protocol.
title: Parallel permanent for F_5 and F_7
